jq.q1:
```bash
jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and (((.title // "") + " " + (.body // "")) | test("security"; "i")))] | length' issues.json
```
jq.q4:
```bash
jq -r '[.[] | select(.is_pr)] | group_by(.user) | map({user: .[0].user, n: length}) | max_by(.n) | [.user, (.n | tostring)] | join(" ")' issues.json
```
jq.q5:
```bash
jq -c '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and (.is_pr | not) and .comments > 5) | .number] | sort' issues.json
```
jq.q8:
```bash
jq '([.[] | select(.is_pr) | .user] | unique) as $p | ([.[] | select(.is_pr | not) | .user] | unique) as $i | [$p[] | select(. as $u | $i | index([$u]) != null)] | length' issues.json
```
jq.q9:
```bash
printf '%.2f\n' "$(jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and (.is_pr | not)) | .comments] | add / length' issues.json)"
```
jq.q10:
```bash
jq '[.[] | select(.state == "open" and (.labels | any(. == "bug")))] | length' issues.json
```

aethershell.q1:
```sh
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(r) => r.state == "open" && ((r.title + " " + r.body) | lower() | contains("security"))) | len()
```
aethershell.q3:
```sh
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(r) => r.state == "closed") | map(fn(r) => r.comments) | sum()
```
aethershell.q4:
```sh
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(r) => r.is_pr) | group("user") | sort_by("Count", "desc") | first | fn(g) => "${g.Name} ${g.Count}"
```
aethershell.q5:
```sh
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(r) => r.state == "open" && r.is_pr == false && r.comments > 5) | map(fn(r) => r.number) | sort()
```
aethershell.q6:
```sh
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | map(fn(r) => r.labels) | flatten() | unique() | len()
```
aethershell.q8:
```sh
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(r) => r.is_pr) | map(fn(r) => r.user) | unique() | where(fn(u) => (cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(r) => r.is_pr == false && r.user == u) | len()) > 0) | len()
```
aethershell.q9:
```sh
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(r) => r.state == "open" && r.is_pr == false) | map(fn(r) => r.comments) | avg() | round(2)
```
aethershell.q10:
```sh
cat("issues.json") | from_json() | where(fn(r) => r.state == "open" && (r.labels | any(fn(l) => l == "bug"))) | len()
```
